description: This script measures the performance of adding new files to the Git object database under different fsync settings. It runs various tests for operations like add, stash, unpack, and commit with different core.fsync configurations.

methods.name: populate_files
methods.description: Creates a specified number of unique files within directories.

methods.name: setup_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository, commits an initial state, and populates files.

methods.name: test_perf_fsync_cfgs
methods.description: Runs performance tests with different core.fsync configurations and Git commands.
